title: viewer.joined (relay → viewer)
description: Successful viewer.join: viewer identity and token, current scene/snapshot versions and whether a cached GLB can be fetched over HTTP; a scene.state message always follows (docs/protocol.md §5.2, §6.5, §8.3).

viewerId.description: Relay-generated viewer identifier, opaque; never a device identifier (§5.2).

snapshotVersion.description: Version of the cached snapshot, or null when the relay holds none (§5.2).

snapshotAvailable.description: true = the viewer SHOULD fetch GET /api/scene/:sceneVersion now (§5.2, §6.5); then `snapshot` is present.

profile.description: Budget profile the publisher exported for (§4.1, §7.5).

if.$comment: §5.2: a fetchable snapshot is described by `snapshot`.
